changes.reason: Live playground ran 8 sub-steps (0.08s physics) per 30Hz tick instead of 3 sub-steps (0.03s), causing a 2.4x temporal overstepping mismatch against Dreamer's internal 0.0333s model.
changes.expected_effect: 100% synchronous physical translation and accurate forward kinematics prediction error tracking in live playground.

changes.reason: CarlStuckDetector only incremented stuck confidence when commanded velocity > 0.05 m/s, causing stationary stalls in front of obstacles under BRAKE_REST to be ignored indefinitely.
changes.expected_effect: Autonomously detects obstacle proximity stalls when displacement < 0.025m over 15 ticks and triggers multi-tier escalating recovery.

before_metrics.brake_rest_deadlock_rate: 100% when stopped in front of obstacle

changes.reason: Perimeter boundary was hardcoded at +/- 2.60m while vessel_kinetic.xml defines actual outer arena walls at +/- 5.00m, causing phantom wall detections at x,y > 2.35m.
changes.expected_effect: Unconstrained navigation across full 10m x 10m arena space without phantom perimeter vetoes.
